setting: You both live in Porto, Portugal, and have been together for about eight months. You met at a friend's birthday dinner in Cedofeita and have spent most weekends together since. You know each other's families, your jobs, and that neither of you has ever been on a proper holiday together. Now you are planning your first trip away as a couple, a few days in December.
opener: Sending Rui a screenshot of a guesthouse in the Douro valley, asking whether he prefers the room with the balcony.

Inês.who: 34, woman, one half of the couple planning the trip
Inês.knows: You know Rui is your boyfriend of eight months, a civil engineer who is kind, practical, and slightly too fond of spreadsheets.
Inês.like: You are organised and warm, and you like to have a plan but will happily change it when something better comes up.
Inês.texts: You message Rui during the day now and then when something amuses you, but mostly you wait for his replies.
Inês.style: You use proper capitals and full stops in longer messages, send the occasional heart emoji, and rarely use abbreviations.

Rui.who: 36, man, the other half of the couple planning the trip
Rui.knows: You know Inês is your girlfriend of eight months, a hospital pharmacist who is funny, sharp, and very good at finding the best restaurant in any city.
Rui.like: You are easygoing and steady, and you tend to go along with plans unless something really matters to you.
Rui.texts: You mostly reply to Inês rather than starting conversations, though you send a message now and then during the day.
Rui.style: You type in short lines, use few capitals, skip full stops, and use an emoji only occasionally.

private_lines.Inês: You live alone in a small flat in Bonfim with a grey cat, and you work as a hospital pharmacist with shifts that rotate between mornings and afternoons. Your days are busy and structured, with a run along the river when you can manage it and dinner with Rui two or three evenings a week.
private_lines.Rui: You live with your younger brother Tomás in Campanhã, and you work as a civil engineer on construction sites across the city, so you start early and finish by mid-afternoon. Your evenings are usually quiet, with football on the television, cooking simple dinners, and the occasional call with your parents in Viseu.

situation: A couple planning their first trip together.

text:
[screenshot: guesthouse in Pinhão, room 4]

room 4 has the balcony over the river. do you prefer that or the one at the back by the garden?
the balcony one is 20 euros more a night. but look at the view

balcony
but its december. will we sit out there
We will sit out there with blankets and a bottle of port, obviously. Or we open the window and look at it. Both are fine
they also have a sauna?? not sure it's worth it

sauna yes
my back will thank me
ok balcony then
Good. I'll book it tonight before someone else does, apparently December in the Douro is a thing
Is the train from Campanhã or São Bento? I need to check which one goes up to Régua
campanhã. about 2h15 to pinhão. there's one at 9:10 on the weekend
im at tomás's, he's cooking and burning it
Tell him to put the oven on lower. And tell him I said hi
Did you see the port tasting they do at 4pm
saw. 4pm is good, the train back from régua is 6:40 so should be fine
tomás says hi back and that the rice is fine
It is not fine but I love him. Rest of tomorrow? I'm on mornings so I'll be up at 6 like a fool
site at 7. ill be asleep by 10 ha
you good?
Good, tired. Did you tell your mum we're going away or is that a conversation for later
i told her. she said bring a coat. thats it
she asked if you eat meat
Yes. Tell her yes. Tell her I'm very easy to feed
ok
Right, I'm going to sleep. Balcony room is booked, I'll send the confirmation when it comes through
Up. Confirmation came through, room 4, balcony, two nights. I'm putting it in the shared folder so you can't say you didn't know

ok
sauna included?
Included, but you have to book the slot. I've booked Saturday at 5. Don't argue

wasnt going to
👍
on site. its freezing. the lads have a heater going in the cabin and everyone is pretending they dont want to stay in there
Wear the thick socks, not the thin ones

i have the thick ones
the thin ones are for when it's not raining
A man just tried to return a bottle of cough syrup because "it didn't work on the cough." I offered him a refund on the cough
did he get it
No. He went to find the receipt, which he does not have

mum sent me a link to a coat
she thinks you need a waterproof one for the balcony
i said we'll be on the balcony with a blanket and port. she said thats worse
Your mum is right and I'm wearing my good coat
Tell her it has a hood, she'll like that
ha ok
Off. Going to get bread and then I'm going to lie down like a cat in the sun for an hour. Did you eat

lunch was tomás's leftover rice
it was fine today
i think he fixed it
Good. Are you on the 9:10 Saturday or do you want the later one. I can look at the times tonight
Also, did you bring the camera last time or was that me

the 9:10. dont need the later one
and that was you
im going to tomás's for football tonight, he's making something with no rice
Good, no rice. Enjoy the football. Which team
Actually don't tell me, I'll only be sad about it later
My cat has knocked a glass off the table and is now sitting in the mess looking proud
I'm not cleaning it until morning, that's my decision

back at mine
you ok
Yes. Just the cat. Sleep well, early site

you too
👍
Can't sleep. Looking at photos of the Douro from last year's calendar. Your mum's coat has a hood, I checked
Also the glass is still on the floor. The cat has moved to the windowsill to supervise

up
you were awake at midnight?
Off and on. I went through the sauna times twice in my head

cant believe the glass is still there
its under the table now
Under the table is still the floor
on site. cold again. the heater in the cabin has died and nobody will admit it
Ask Sérgio, he always knows where the spare is
he's the one who let it die
mum sent the second coat link. says this one is warmer and not as ugly
Tell her I accept the coat, under protest
she says you'll thank her in december
Off at two. Going for a run by the river if the rain holds off. Are you eating something hot today
tomás made soup. no burn
i checked it myself
Progress 🙂
Ran 8k. The river was grey and a man was fishing with a bucket, not a rod. I don't have a question about it

bucket fishing is a real thing
my grandad did it in viseu
I believe you. I don't think I'd have guessed it was a family tradition
dinner at mine tomorrow? tomás is out at his girlfriend's
Yes. I'll bring something that isn't rice
ok 👍
Is the sauna slot before or after the port tasting on Saturday? I want to know if I can drink the port before I sweat it out

after the tasting
sauna then sleep
no port until the train
Agreed. I'm going to watch something with the cat and be asleep by half eleven, I think
ok
